title: Modbot term list
description: A shareable set of rules for screening VRChat profile text (bio, display name, status, pronouns). Lists are data, not code: Modbot ships none enabled by default, and a group chooses which to import. See foundation spec 4.2.6.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. modbot_racist_terms. Never changes once published.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the picker.

description.description: One or two sentences: what this list is for and who should enable it.

source.description: Where this list came from. Official lists use 'modbot'; imported lists record the instance URL they came from.

suitableFor.description: Community types this list is appropriate for. Drives the picker's suggestions; never auto-enables anything.

severity.description: note = record it only. review = flag for a moderator. high = flag prominently and notify. Nothing auto-actions unless a group opts that rule in explicitly.

id.description: Optional stable id so a group can disable one rule without forking the list.

category.description: Groups rules for reporting and per-category dismissal rates, e.g. racism, transphobia, sexual, profanity, extremism, advertising, harassment, political.

note.description: Why this rule exists, and what a false positive looks like. Shown to the reviewing moderator.

fields.description: Which profile fields to check. Defaults to all.

match.description: Literal text. Matched after normalisation (NFKC, confusable folding, zero-width and combining-mark stripping, separator collapsing) so leetspeak and homoglyph evasion still match.

wholeWord.description: Require word boundaries. Leave true unless the term is a fragment; false is how you catch substrings but also how you catch Scunthorpe.

regex.description: RE2-safe regular expression. No backreferences, no lookaround -- these run against untrusted input at sync rate and must not backtrack.

allOf.description: Every one of these must be present.

anyOf.description: At least one of these must be present.

noneOf.description: Suppress the match if any of these appear -- the escape hatch for quoting, condemning or discussing.

withinWords.description: All required parts must appear within this many words of each other. Proximity is what separates a phrase from two unrelated words in a long bio.

prompt.description: A policy stated in plain language, e.g. 'Political campaigning or partisan statements'. Evaluated by the configured AI provider (M8 section 4). Advisory only -- topics can never auto-action.

examples.description: Illustrative matches, used to steer the model.

counterExamples.description: Illustrative non-matches. As important as the examples -- this is where false positives get headed off.
